mapper.select: SELECT ma.id AS mediaAssetId, ma.asset_type AS mediaType, ma.storage_mode AS storageMode, ma.duration_ms AS durationMs, ma.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, ma.sha256 AS checksum FROM media_assets ma WHERE ma.id = #{mediaAssetId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ma.account_id = #{ownerId} AND ma.status = 'READY' AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL AND ma.asset_type IN ('IMAGE', 'VIDEO') AND ( ma.storage_mode <> 'LOCAL_ONLY' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM local_media_materializations lmm WHERE lmm.project_id = #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND lmm.media_asset_id = ma.id AND lmm.state = 'AVAILABLE' ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO production_beat_media_selections ( project_id, visual_beat_id, media_asset_id, fit_mode, trim_start_ms ) VALUES ( #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{visualBeatId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{mediaAssetId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{fitMode}, #{trimStartMs} ) ON CONFLICT (project_id, visual_beat_id) DO UPDATE SET media_asset_id = EXCLUDED.media_asset_id, fit_mode = EXCLUDED.fit_mode, trim_start_ms = EXCLUDED.trim_start_ms, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = production_beat_media_selections.row_version + 1
